judgments.rewrite_hint: Quote: “Gasoline prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.” Replace the gasoline-wide claim with a statement specifically about Brent crude oil futures, limited to the movement reported in HF-009.

Quote: “World energy prices did not fall after the plan was withdrawn, and stayed high across all energy markets.” Narrow the claim to the Brent futures movement and reporting-time snapshot recorded in HF-009; do not generalize to world energy markets.

Quote: “All crude benchmarks moved the same way after the plan was withdrawn, staying high across the board.” Narrow the statement to the Brent futures movement in HF-009; the Ledger does not establish that all crude benchmarks moved alike.

Quote: “Oil prices fell sharply across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.” Replace this with HF-009’s reported movement: Brent futures briefly lost some gains, then returned near their earlier high level.

Quote: “The fee plan left the stage, but the events driving oil prices—and the prices themselves—quickly returned.” Replace the implication that the price-driving events resumed with the HF-009 account that tensions and related concerns continued while Brent briefly narrowed its gains and then recovered.
